notes: run_exit measured without a pipe (timeout + direct exit echo); earlier piped runs reported the pipe's status, not the program's, and are not used for exit claims.
tak_float was run with stdout redirected to a file under timeout 1, as in R86, to avoid flooding the tool.

probes.name: div_literal
probes.result: E_SHUNYA_BHAJAN pankti 2, exit 1, nothing after printed

probes.name: empty_madhya
probes.program: prakriya madhya(kosh dasham a) { nivartanam 1.0 / kosh_len(a) }, called with an empty kosh
probes.result: E_SHUNYA_BHAJAN pankti 3, stops (v279 would have printed inf)

probes.name: overflow
probes.program: dasham inf = 10.0; 400x inf = inf * 10.0; n = inf - inf
probes.result: prints inf, then nan; nan == 2.0 -> 0, nan != 2.0 -> 1, nan < 2.0 -> 0, inf > 2.0 -> 1 (IEEE)

probes.name: huge_literal
probes.result: prints inf, program carries on (no refusal)

probes.name: trunc
probes.program: vitti i = 7.5 / 2.0; dasham d = 3.7, vitti j = d; dasham e = 3.0, vitti k = e
probes.result: i = 3, j = 3, k = 3 (computed truncation still silent; integral converts correctly)
